The disk edema and retinopathy resolves after the hypertension is controlled.2 Optic disc swelling in patients with systemic vascular disease like diabetes and hypertension can be differentiated form neuroretinitis by the absence of abrupt visual loss, background retinopathy and a medical history of such optic conditions. Spontaneous resolution of the disc edema and recovery of visual acuity serve as distinguishing features of neuroretinitis from papilledema and ischemic optic neuropathy
